create_constant_initializer: create a Constant initializer that fills weights with a fixed scalar value
create_random_normal_initializer: create a RandomNormal initializer to sample weights from a Gaussian distribution with given stddev
create_variance_scaling_initializer: create a VarianceScaling initializer to scale weights by fan-in or fan-out of the layer
create_orthogonal_initializer: create an Orthogonal initializer that generates orthogonal weight matrices via QR decomposition
create_identity_initializer: create an Identity initializer that produces an identity matrix optionally scaled by a gain factor
